\noindent
Algorithms~S1 to~S3 give protocol detail referenced from the main article:
cascading enrollment, residue encoding with two-of-three recovery, and
revocation publication with cache invalidation. Section~S2 records two
operational observations from the deployment that no performance metric
captures. Every number quoted here expands from the same generated macro file
the main article uses, so both regenerate together from
\texttt{analysis/derive\_results.py} in the released artifact.
